title: Winter of Code 5.0 Inaugural Ceremony
description: The official kickoff of Winter of Code 5.0 - welcoming contributors to a GSoC-inspired open-source journey.
detailedDescription: The Inaugural Ceremony of Winter of Code 5.0 marks the official kickoff of a GSoC-inspired open-source program aimed at empowering students and developers to begin and grow their open-source journey. This session sets the vision, goals, and impact of WoC 5.0, introduces the community to the program structure, and features inspiring talks from renowned industry leaders and open-source advocates. With insights from global speakers, the ceremony is designed to ignite curiosity, motivation, and confidence in contributors as they step into the world of open source.
agenda: Welcome note and opening of Winter of Code 5.0
Introduction to Winter of Code and its GSoC-inspired vision
Program goals, structure, and timeline overview
Keynote and talks by industry leaders and open-source advocates
Insights and experiences from global open-source contributors
What participants can expect from WoC 5.0
Community values, collaboration, and code of conduct
Official inauguration and closing remarks

title: Open Source 101
description: A practical introduction to open source, GSoC, and GitHub-straight from a GSoC 2025 mentor.
detailedDescription: Open Source 101 is a beginner-friendly yet insightful session designed to help students and developers take their first confident steps into open source. Led by Amaan Bhati, DevRel Engineer at Keploy and Google Summer of Code (GSoC) 2025 Mentor, this session will cover the fundamentals of open source contributions, how programs like GSoC work, effective proposal writing strategies, and essential Git & GitHub workflows. Whether you’re just starting out or planning to apply for GSoC, this session will give you a clear roadmap and practical guidance from someone actively working in the ecosystem.
agenda: Introduction to Open Source and why it matters
Understanding the open-source ecosystem
Overview of Google Summer of Code (GSoC)
How to get started with open source contributions
Basics of GSoC proposal writing
Git & GitHub fundamentals (repositories, issues, pull requests)
Common beginner mistakes and best practices
Live Q&A with a DevRel Engineer and GSoC 2025 Mentor

title: Frontend Development with UI Libraries
description: Learn fast and effective frontend development with Next.js, UI libraries, and open source tools from a GSoC 2025 mentor.
detailedDescription: Frontend Development with UI Libraries is an interactive session designed for developers who want to build fast, scalable, and beautiful web applications. Led by Amaan Bhati, DevRel Engineer at Keploy and Google Summer of Code (GSoC) 2025 Mentor, this session will dive into modern frontend development using Next.js, best UI/UX practices, and the power of open source UI libraries. You’ll also see a live demonstration on how to quickly test APIs using Keploy. Whether you’re a beginner or an intermediate frontend developer, this session will help you level up your workflow and connect with like-minded developers.
agenda: Introduction to modern frontend development
Why Next.js is powerful for fast frontend apps
Best UI/UX practices for scalable applications
Using open source UI libraries effectively
Speeding up development with ready-made components
Live demo: Testing APIs quickly with Keploy
Tips for becoming a better frontend engineer
Live Q&A and networking

title: Fullstack 101
description: Kickstart your journey into Full Stack Development by learning how frontend and backend come together to build powerful applications.
detailedDescription: Full Stack 101 is an insightful online session crafted to introduce participants to the exciting and ever-evolving world of Full Stack Development. This session is perfect for frontend developers who want to understand backend systems, backend developers aiming to create better user experiences, and beginners curious about how complete web applications are built. You’ll explore the core concepts of frontend and backend development, how they communicate, and the essential tools and technologies used by full stack developers today. Guided by an experienced speaker, this session focuses on practical understanding, real-world workflows, and best practices to help you build dynamic, efficient, and scalable applications. Join us to learn, interact, and connect with peers who share your passion for building end-to-end solutions.
agenda: Welcome and session overview
What is Full Stack Development?
Understanding frontend fundamentals
Introduction to backend systems and APIs
How frontend and backend work together
Overview of popular full stack tools and tech stacks
Best practices for building scalable applications
Roadmap and tips for aspiring full stack developers
Live Q&A and networking

title: Blockchain Simplified
description: A beginner-friendly yet insightful session breaking down blockchain fundamentals, real-world applications, and future opportunities.
detailedDescription: Join us for “Blockchain Simplified”, an engaging and easy-to-understand session designed to demystify one of the most revolutionary technologies of our time. Blockchain is more than just cryptocurrency - it is transforming industries such as finance, healthcare, supply chain, gaming, governance, and beyond. In this session, we will start from the very basics - understanding what blockchain is, how it works, and why it is considered decentralized and secure. We will explore key concepts such as distributed ledgers, consensus mechanisms, smart contracts, and Web3. You'll also discover how platforms like Ethereum and Bitcoin operate, and how developers can build decentralized applications (dApps). Whether you're a complete beginner or someone curious about blockchain development, this session will give you clarity, direction, and inspiration to explore this fast-growing domain.
agenda: Welcome and session overview
What is Blockchain and why it matters?
Understanding blocks, hashing, and distributed ledgers
Consensus mechanisms: Proof of Work vs Proof of Stake
Introduction to Smart Contracts and dApps
Real-world applications of blockchain technology
Overview of Ethereum and the Web3 ecosystem
Career roadmap and opportunities in Blockchain
Live Q&A and networking
